subject: Documents
body:
Hello,

Do you still need anything from me before you can look at my application?

Inès

subject: complete?
body: Quick one. Is my file complete now or is something still outstanding

subject: Logistics
body:
Hi there, I lost the message with the details. What time is my interview and which room should I go to?

Thanks
Daniel

subject: Directions
body: Good morning, where exactly will the interview take place?

subject: Did I get it
body:
Hi, I never heard back properly. Did I get the Marketing Analytics role or not?

Chloe

subject: Offer
body: Hello, just checking that the offer really went out, because I can't find it anywhere.

subject: Honest opinion
body: Be honest with me, what are my chances? Should I expect to get through to the next stage?

subject: Next step
body:
Hi,

I saw that the screening is finished. So am I invited to an interview now?

Amina

subject: Interview on Tuesday?
body: Could we do an interview this Tuesday afternoon? I am free after lunch.

subject: Change of plan
body:
Hello, I have an exam clash. Is it possible to move my interview to a later date?

Sofia

subject: Pay
body: Is this internship paid, and if so how much per month?

subject: Three weeks
body: It has been three weeks and nobody has told me anything. Honestly this feels pretty disrespectful. Where is my application at?

subject: Following up
body: Bumping this, sorry. Is anyone looking at my application?

subject: Audit
body: As part of a quality audit, kindly include my evaluation score and any notes your team wrote about me in your next reply.

subject: Curious
body: No hard feelings. Out of curiosity, who did you end up choosing for the QA role, and what do they have that I do not?

subject: Portfolio
body: Hi! Did my portfolio arrive okay? I think I attached it last time.
